canon_events_team_size_check.name: canon_events_team_size_check
canon_events_team_size_check.value:
("canon_events"."participation" = 'individual' AND "canon_events"."team_min" IS NULL AND "canon_events"."team_max" IS NULL)
        OR ("canon_events"."participation" <> 'individual' AND "canon_events"."team_min" IS NOT NULL AND "canon_events"."team_max" IS NOT NULL
            AND "canon_events"."team_min" >= 2 AND "canon_events"."team_min" <= "canon_events"."team_max" AND "canon_events"."team_max" <= 10)

forum_events_time_order_check.name: forum_events_time_order_check
forum_events_time_order_check.value: "forum_events"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "forum_events"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "forum_events"."ends_at" > "forum_events"."starts_at"
